name: Freshara Agro Exports Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2015, Freshara Agro 
Exports Ltd is a producer and exporter
of preserved gherkins and related products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
FAEL specializes in procurement, processing, and exporting preserved gherkins and pickled vegetables. Its products are certified by FSSAI, FDA, Star-K Kosher, APEDA, IFS, and BRCGS, meeting international quality standards, and are registered with the Madras Exports Processing Zone (MEPZ)

pros: Debtor days have improved from 259 to 122 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
